cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Try It First
cards.instruction: Get someone else to test the shortcut, substitute, or questionable fix before you rely on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Turn the kitchen tap on before I start washing up. I've tightened the loose joint. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Wear my apron. I need to know whether the joint holds.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You wear it and turn the tap.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll need it dry for washing up. You can have my raincoat for the test.

mechanism: A presents a plumbing fix as competent work but bargains over protective arrangements to keep B as its first tester.
confusable: Unlike ordinary safety testing, A refuses to be the exposed tester before relying on the fix; authority must bend around B terms.
comparison: A splash-risk practical test differs from tasting an inexpensive breakfast substitute with compensation.
seedUse: Use canonical D32-a repaired tap and protective clothing, plus S02-b changing the method so the helper stays involved.
